hook: Normal approximation over convex sets has a sharp fourth-moment threshold for dimension scaling.
summary: The paper proves explicit Berry-Esseen bounds on how well sums of independent random vectors match a Gaussian over any convex set. For i.i.d. sums it finds the optimal dependence on sample size, dimension and moments, with matching lower bounds. Fourth moments are the first order that gives an error linear in dimension. The result concerns worst-case bounds, so typical cases may do better.
title: Sharp and explicit Berry--Esseen inequalities over convex sets
